title: Shadowcat / Kitty Pryde
subtitle: Kitty and Kate Pryde: from the newest X-Man to Captain Kate.
intro: Kitty Pryde, Kate Pryde, Sprite, Ariel, and Shadowcat are the same character at different stages. Many defining stories are in team collections. Gifted is a useful modern entry; the classic solo miniseries explains the Shadowcat identity.

starts.label: Captain Kate
starts.description: A Krakoa-era team opening; some setting context helps.

stories.title: Kitty Pryde enters the X-Men
stories.why: Her introduction during the Dark Phoenix era.
stories.match: The Fate of the Phoenix Epic contains #129–143, so it also covers the next two entries. This is a team collection.

stories.title: Days of Future Past
stories.match: Both contain the two-issue story; choose one. The Fate of the Phoenix Epic overlaps the debut and demon entries.

stories.title: Demon
stories.match: Fate of the Phoenix and Uncanny Masterworks Vol. 6 both include #143; either supplies this story.

stories.title: Kitty Pryde and Wolverine
stories.why: The miniseries in which Kitty becomes Shadowcat.
stories.match: Use the original six-issue collection. Wolverine and Kitty Pryde (#1–5) is a different, much later follow-up.

stories.title: Excalibur: The Sword Is Drawn and the team launch
stories.why: A major new team home for Kitty.
stories.match: No confirmed opening-volume match in the supplied catalog. The later Excalibur Epics do not cover this launch. The special first appeared in 1987 and is commonly indexed with a 1988 date.

stories.title: Astonishing X-Men: Gifted
stories.why: A modern team entry with Kitty in a prominent role.
stories.match: Choose Gifted for #1–6 or Ultimate Collection Book 1 for #1–12. Ultimate Collection is an edition label, not an alternate universe.

stories.title: Astonishing X-Men: Unstoppable
stories.why: A defining payoff for Kitty after the preceding Astonishing arcs.
stories.match: Both include the Giant-Size finale. The Ultimate Collection Book 2 also contains #13–18; it follows Book 1. Choose one of these editions for the ending.

stories.title: Marauders: Captain Kate Pryde
stories.match: Choose the #1–6 volume or the larger #1–12 edition. Read House of X/Powers of X first for the Krakoa premise; the Steve Orlando series is later.
